title: 第5章 上官惊鸿
content_zh:
演武场中，上官惊鸿笔直地站立着，没有穿戴盔甲，而是一身华服。看起来三十多岁，身材魁梧，四方脸庞，眉毛很粗，给人一种莽夫的感觉。真这么认为的人，都已经在上官惊鸿这里吃过亏了。身为飞羽王朝的左将军，战场官场，勾心斗角，怎么可能是个莽夫？

常年征战，皮肤闪耀着古铜色，浑身上下流露着一股煞气。上官惊鸿从军二十年，不知道刀下有多少亡魂。

天玄大陆，强者为尊，武力至上。打起仗来，靠的就是拼杀，杀的人多，杀的人职位高，功劳就大。在这里，没有什么系统的兵法，有的只是兵对兵，将对将。

上官惊鸿在飞羽王朝也是高手，不然也不可能达到如今的地位。没有足够的武道修为，是很难谋取到高位的。整个飞羽王朝，只有一人特殊，那就是智绝王。据传智绝王连人极境武者都不是，但是却是王爷，比上官惊鸿的地位还高。

天地人神鬼，王极境共分为这五重。天王境，地王境，人王境，神王境，鬼王境。上官惊鸿在几年前就已经是神王境强者了，不过对于他的出身来说很正常。

他出自于真武门，只是一直是个外围弟子，后来不得不来到飞羽王朝发展。在真武门，就算他如今神王境的修为，也算不了什么。真武门历史及其悠久，是一个无上大教。

真武门第一任掌门，更是帝极境强者。道无经不传，真武大帝消失之前，留下了《真武经》。大帝所创的帝经，皆是大帝生平感悟。一个门派有了帝经，想不强大都难。

“不恨古帝不得见，恨其不知吾之能。待到天地破灭时，九天十地真武临！”

真武大帝的传说很多很多，上官惊鸿也是记得这句真武大帝消失之前留下的话语。每每想起这句话，他就一阵崇拜。那是一种高处不胜寒的寂寞，那是一种举世无敌的寂寥，那是一种让所有人都要仰望的境界。

只不过他在真武门只是外门弟子，《真武经》他是见也没机会见到。外门弟子自然也有古经可学，只是帝经他们是接触不到的。他所学的就是《归元经》，据说是一位先贤所创。

就是这《归元经》，上官惊鸿也是当成至宝来收藏的。在真武门是很寻常，不过在飞羽王朝，真的是传说中才有的经书了。在整个上官家，也就只有他的大儿子和二儿子学过。小女儿上官倾城岁数还小，况且只是捡来的而已。当年在外征战回来，看到一个女婴被弃于荒郊野外，就收养了起来，等将来长大作为工具嫁出去。

上官惊鸿又想起了那尊伟岸的身影，那睥睨天下的英姿，那舍我其谁的气质。那仿佛是传说中的一尊神明，他活了这么多年，从来没有感觉到哪一个人能比得上那尊身影。

他作为真武门外围弟子，也是有幸见过真武门的掌门。作为一个无上大教的掌门，法力滔天，他知道掌门绝对是天极境的强者。天极境，那是上官惊鸿一辈子也指望不上的境界。就算他的百万大军冲过去，也不够天极境强者几招杀的。

但是如果要拿来与那尊身影相比的话，就仿佛萤火之光与皓月争辉！尽管他没有见过两人出手，仅凭直觉就做出了这样的判断。但是他坚信这个判断没有错误，武者的直觉很重要，也向来准确。

那人就是上官羽的亲生父亲，也是自己的救命恩人。只是当初，那人说要去做一件很重要的事情，而把儿子交给他抚养成人。

那一刻，上官惊鸿感觉到老天是如此的眷顾他，这种传说中的人物，能为他做事，真的是什么都值了。

不过那人说，如果三年之内回不来，那说明永远也回不来了。上官惊鸿并没有插得上嘴，在那人面前，他深深地感觉到了自己的渺小。

后来那人就消失了，留下了如今的上官羽。那三年中，他是对上官羽百般呵护，万般疼爱，甚至想当成小祖宗一样供着。为了在那种人物面前表现下，他连自己的儿子上官建城都不管了。

可惜，三年后那尊身影并没有回来。上官惊鸿不知道那人还会不会回来，不过依旧将上官羽当成亲生儿子看待。

众所周知，血脉之力是很重要很重要的。所谓龙生龙，凤生凤，强者的儿子不一定能超越其父，但是肯定不差。越强大的人，后代就越强大，这就是血脉的好处了。

那尊身影是那么的高不可攀，想来定然是绝世强者，那么他的亲生儿子肯定不会差了。上官惊鸿是这么想的，只可信天不遂人愿……

在后来，发生了一件上官惊鸿无论如何也想不到的事情。上官羽竟然不能修炼武道，这实在是太出乎他的意料了。上官羽从小就异于常人，看起来将来注定不凡，谁知道连武道的门槛都他不进去。

他不信，他也不愿相信。因此，他找了很多人，想找出上官羽不能修炼的原因。渐渐地，他绝望了，上官羽真的不能修炼武道。

那么多年的努力，全都白费了，换来这么一个废物，他是哭都没地方哭的。他是越来越不待见上官羽了，甚至是越看越厌恶。

后来就算知道上官羽受到上官建城的排挤，就算知道上官羽衣食住行都和下人一个档次，他也没有过问丝毫。反正这个废物，他是眼不见心不烦，看不到最好。

直到今日，那尊身影也没有回来，想来是真的回不来了。不过他也不敢杀了上官羽，那种境界的人物不是他可以想象的，指不定留下了什么后手。万一因为一时冲动，葬送了自己的性命，那可就大大的划不来了。

一阵急促的脚步声打断了上官惊鸿的遐想，他皱起了眉头。远远地看到了马文，武者到了他这种境界，视力都是极好的。马文是个很会做事的人，平时不会到这里来打扰他，现在肯定是发生了处理不了的事情了。

“马文，发生了什么事如此慌慌张张？”马文还没走到跟前，就听到了上官惊鸿的声音。

马文的行动速度实在是与他的体形不太相配，这么一个胖子竟然能跑得那么快。上官惊鸿甚至能感觉到演武场一抖一抖的，真不知道马文是吃什么长的。

马文来到上官惊鸿跟前，“启禀老爷，府中发生了一件事情，要交给老爷亲自处理！”

“什么事？”上官惊鸿不觉得府中能发生什么事，所以声音不咸不淡。

“就在刚才，府中陆宏与小少爷发生争执，然后陆宏被小少爷一拳打死了！”

这句话一说，上官惊鸿就真的震惊了，不过面上并没有表现出来。他第一个想到的不是与他一起长大的陆宏死得冤不冤，死得惨不惨。他想的是，上官羽是不是已经踏入修炼的道路了，否则怎么能把行伍出身的陆宏一拳打死？

马文感觉到上官惊鸿很重视这件事情，因此尽量保持着语气的平稳，没有任何添油加醋，原原本本的将这件事和上官惊鸿说了一遍。

“也就是说，陆宏其实反抗了，只是还是被上官羽打死了？”

“好，我知道了，你去将上官羽叫过来，这件事情我亲自处理！”

马文交代了这件事情之后，顿时觉得神清气爽，也恢复了往日的常态。向上官惊鸿告退之后，他就往上官羽那里的院子走去了。

等马文走后，上官惊鸿又独自一人思索了起来。按理说，一个十二岁的少年，是不可能一拳将一个行伍出身的士兵打死的。

上官羽可能早就能修炼了，只是怨恨他这些年的表现，因此不想告诉他。他越想越觉得是这么回事，那尊身影是那么的强大，他的儿子又怎么可能差得了呢？

而且这么一个十二岁的少年，杀人却没有丝毫犹豫，如此杀伐果断，将来必成大器。既然这样，那么这个时候就应该将上官羽和他绑在一起。

再说，这个世上独行侠毕竟很少，那尊身影背后可能有某个超级家族或者无上大教。等将来上官羽回去了，那他也能跟着沾光了。

他以前是对不起上官羽，不过以后只要他继续对上官羽好就行了。一个十二岁的孩子，他还能搞不定吗？孩子生气哄哄不就好了，为了将来的发展，哄一个孩子又算得了什么？

上官惊鸿深深地吸了口气，心里已经想好了怎么处理这件事情。

他拿起了自己的宝刀，在演武场中演练起了自己的刀法。场中漫天刀光，一道道破空声，各种绝技相继使出。

就算没有动用元气，他的刀法也能打出该有的精髓。这是《归元经》中所记载的绝技，他自然是勤练不缀。

只是他的心里正在期待上官羽的到来……

今天早上起来写了这章，手都冻僵了，好冷……
content_en:
In the martial arts arena, Shangguan Jinghong stood upright, not wearing armor, but wearing a rich uniform.He looks to be in his thirties, with a tall build, a square face, and thick eyebrows, giving him the impression of a reckless man.Anyone who really thinks so has already suffered losses from Shangguan Jinghong.As General Zuo of the Feiyu Dynasty, he was involved in officialdom and intrigues on the battlefield, so how could he be a reckless man?

After years of fighting, his skin shines with a bronze color, and his whole body exudes an evil aura.Shangguan Jinghong has been in the army for twenty years, and he doesn't know how many souls he has killed under his sword.

In Tianxuan Continent, the strong are respected and force is supreme.When fighting a war, you rely on fighting. The more people you kill, the higher the position of the person who kills, the greater the credit will be.Here, there is no systematic art of war, only soldiers against soldiers, against generals.

Shangguan Jinghong was also a master in Feiyu Dynasty, otherwise he would not have reached his current status.Without sufficient martial arts cultivation, it is difficult to obtain a high position.In the entire Feiyu Dynasty, there was only one special person, and that was King Zhijue.It is said that King Zhijue is not even a warrior in the Human Realm, but he is a prince, with a higher status than Shangguan Jinghong.

Heaven, earth, humans, gods and ghosts, the King's Realm is divided into these five levels.The realm of the King of Heaven, the realm of the Earthly King, the realm of the Human King, the realm of the God King, and the realm of the Ghost King.Shangguan Jinghong had already reached the level of God King a few years ago, but this was normal for his origin.

He came from the Zhenwu Sect, but had always been a peripheral disciple, and later had to come to the Feiyu Dynasty to develop.In Zhenwu Sect, even his current cultivation level at the God King Realm is nothing.Zhenwu Sect has an extremely long history and is a supreme sect.

The first head of the Zhenwu Sect was a powerful person in the Emperor's Realm.The Tao cannot be passed on without its scriptures. Before Emperor Zhenwu disappeared, he left behind the "Zhenwu Jing".The Imperial Scriptures created by the Great Emperor are all inspired by the Emperor's life.Once a sect has the Emperor Scripture, it is difficult for it not to become powerful.

"I don't hate the ancient emperor for not being able to see him, but I hate that he doesn't know what I can do. When the heaven and the earth are shattered, the true power of the nine heavens and ten earths will come!"

There are many legends about Emperor Zhenwu, and Shangguan Jinghong also remembered these words left by Emperor Zhenwu before he disappeared.Every time he thought of this sentence, he felt a burst of admiration.It is a kind of loneliness that is overwhelming at a high place. It is a kind of loneliness that is invincible in the world. It is a state that everyone must look up to.

It's just that he is only an outer disciple in Zhenwu Sect, and he has no chance to see the "Zhenwu Sutra".Of course, the outer disciples also have ancient scriptures to learn, but they cannot access the Imperial scriptures.What he studied was the Guiyuan Jing, which is said to have been created by a sage.

Even this "Guiyuan Jing" was collected by Shangguan Jinghong as a treasure.It is very common in Zhenwu Sect, but in Feiyu Dynasty, it is really a legendary scripture.In the entire Shangguan family, only his eldest son and second son have learned it.The youngest daughter, Shangguan Qingcheng, is still young, and besides, she was just picked up.When I came back from the war, I saw a baby girl abandoned in the wilderness, so I adopted her and used her as a tool to marry off when she grew up.

Shangguan Jinghong thought of that majestic figure again, that heroic posture that looked down upon the world, and that temperament that was like no other.It seemed to be a legendary god. He had lived for so many years, and he had never felt that anyone could compare to that figure.

As a peripheral disciple of Zhenwu Sect, he was also lucky enough to meet the leader of Zhenwu Sect.As the leader of a supreme sect with immense magical power, he knew that the leader was definitely a powerful person in the Tianji Realm.The Tianji Realm is a realm that Shangguan Jinghong can't hope to achieve in his life.Even if his army of one million rushed over, it wouldn't be enough for a strong person from the Tianji Realm to kill him with just a few moves.

But if you want to compare it with that figure, it is like the light of fireflies competing with the bright moon!Although he had never seen the two of them take action, he made this judgment based on intuition.But he firmly believed that this judgment was not wrong. A warrior's intuition was very important and always accurate.

That man was Shangguan Yu's biological father and his savior.But at the beginning, the man said that he wanted to do something very important and left his son to be raised by him.

At that moment, Shangguan Jinghong felt that God was so favoring him. For such a legendary figure to do something for him, it was really worth everything.

But the man said that if he couldn't come back within three years, it meant he would never come back.Shangguan Jinghong was not able to interrupt. In front of that man, he deeply felt his own insignificance.

Later, that person disappeared, leaving Shangguan Yu today.During those three years, he cared for and loved Shangguan Yu in every possible way, and even wanted to worship Shangguan Yu like a little ancestor.In order to perform in front of that kind of person, he even ignored his son Shangguan Jiancheng.

Unfortunately, the figure did not come back three years later.Shangguan Jinghong didn't know if that man would come back, but he still regarded Shangguan Yu as his biological son.

As we all know, the power of blood is very important.As the saying goes, a dragon begets a dragon, and a phoenix begets a phoenix. The son of a strong man may not be able to surpass his father, but he is certainly not bad.The more powerful a person is, the more powerful his descendants will be. This is the benefit of bloodline.

That figure was so unattainable that he must be a peerless strong man, so his biological son would definitely be the best.This is what Shangguan Jinghong thinks. He can only believe that God will not fulfill his wishes...

Later, something happened that Shangguan Jinghong could not have imagined.Shangguan Yu couldn't practice martial arts, which was really beyond his expectation.Shangguan Yu has been different from ordinary people since he was a child, and it seems that he is destined to be extraordinary in the future. Who knew that he would not even be able to enter the threshold of martial arts.

He didn't believe it, and he didn't want to believe it.Therefore, he found many people to find out why Shangguan Yu could not practice.Gradually, he despaired. Shangguan Yu really couldn't practice martial arts.

So many years of hard work were all in vain. In exchange for such a waste, he had no place to cry.He disliked seeing Shangguan Yu less and less, and even grew more disgusted with him.

Later, even if he knew that Shangguan Yu was being squeezed out by Shangguan Jiancheng, and even if he knew that Shangguan Yu's clothing, food, housing, and transportation were on the same level as those of his subordinates, he didn't bother him at all.Anyway, he was out of sight, out of mind, and couldn't see the best of this trash.

To this day, that figure has not come back. I think it is really impossible to come back.However, he did not dare to kill Shangguan Yu. He could not imagine a person of that level, and he might have left some back-up plan.If he loses his life due to impulsiveness, it will be worthless.

A burst of rapid footsteps interrupted Shangguan Jinghong's reverie, and he frowned.I saw Ma Wen from a distance. When a warrior reaches his level, his eyesight is extremely good.Marvin is a very good person and would not bother him here usually. Now something must have happened that he cannot handle.

"Marvin, what happened to make you so panicked?" Before Marvin could even reach the front, he heard Shangguan Jinghong's voice.

Marvin's movement speed really didn't match his body shape. Such a fat man could run so fast.Shangguan Jinghong could even feel the trembling in the martial arts arena. He really didn't know what Marwen was doing.

Ma Wen came to Shangguan Jinghong and said, "Master Qi, something happened in the house, and it needs to be handled by the master himself!"

"What's going on?" Shangguan Jinghong didn't think anything could happen in the house, so his voice was neither salty nor cool.

"Just now, Lu Hong and the young master had a dispute in the mansion, and then Lu Hong was punched to death by the young master!"

Shangguan Jinghong was really shocked as soon as he said this, but he didn't show it on his face.His first thought was not whether Lu Hong, who grew up with him, died unjustly or miserably.What he was thinking was whether Shangguan Yu had already entered the path of cultivation. Otherwise, how could he punch Lu Hong to death, who was born in the army?

Marvin felt that Shangguan Jinghong attached great importance to this matter, so he tried to keep his tone as calm as possible without adding any exaggeration, and told Shangguan Jinghong the matter as it was.

"In other words, Lu Hong actually resisted, but was still beaten to death by Shangguan Yu?"

"Okay, I understand, go and call Shangguan Yu over, I will handle this matter myself!"

After Marvin explained this matter, he suddenly felt refreshed and returned to his usual normal state.After bidding farewell to Shangguan Jinghong, he walked to Shangguan Yu's yard.

After Marvin left, Shangguan Jinghong began to think alone again.Logically speaking, it is impossible for a twelve-year-old boy to beat a soldier from the army to death with one punch.

Shangguan Yu might have been able to practice a long time ago, but he just resented his performance over the years, so he didn't want to tell him.The more he thought about it, the more he realized that this was the case. That figure was so powerful, how could his son be any worse?

Moreover, such a twelve-year-old boy kills without any hesitation. He is so decisive in killing and will definitely become a great weapon in the future.In this case, Shangguan Yu should be tied to him at this time.

Besides, there are very few lone rangers in this world. There may be some super family or supreme religion behind that figure.When Shangguan Yu goes back in the future, he will also be able to benefit from it.

He was sorry to Shangguan Yu before, but in the future, as long as he continues to treat Shangguan Yu well, it will be fine.How could a twelve-year-old kid still be unable to handle this?It's better to coax a child when he's angry. For the sake of future development, what's the point of coaxing a child?

Shangguan Jinghong took a deep breath and already thought about how to deal with this matter.

He picked up his sword and practiced his sword skills in the martial arts arena.The field was filled with the light of swords, sounds of piercing the air, and various stunts were performed one after another.

Even without using his vitality, his sword skills can still bring out the essence of what they should be.This is a unique skill recorded in the "Guiyuan Jing", so he naturally practiced it diligently.

But in his heart he was looking forward to Shangguan Yu's arrival...

I woke up this morning and wrote this chapter. My hands were frozen, so cold...
